verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a case-management queue for reviewing risk alerts. Cases can be filtered by customer risk, stage, assignee and date, and analysts record standardized decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected – accepted', 'risk detected – offboard'). Transaction monitoring generates cases and alerts that are reviewable in the web app, with a per-case audit trail. The evidence does not show that a case view brings together the full context the story asks for. missing for 10: evidence that a case displays customer history and triggering signals in one place, any similar-case surfacing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the transaction review queue.
